response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed
